def cache_get(self, key):
        self._lock.acquire()
        entry = self._store.get(key)
        if entry is not None and not entry.is_stale():

        value = self._recompute(key) if entry is None else entry.value
        self._store[key] = Entry(value, time.time())
        self._lock.release()
        return value

    qty = order.line_items.sum(&:quantity)
    rate = DISCOUNT_TIERS.select { |threshold, _| qty > threshold }.values.max || 0

def discount_for(order, subtotal)
    qty = order.line_items.sum(&:quantity)
    rate = DISCOUNT_TIERS.select { |threshold, _| qty >= threshold }.values.max || 0
    (subtotal * rate).round
  end

reasoning: Passing subtotal through avoids recomputing it, and I updated the discount predicate while I was in there.
